slides.visibleText:
t ← 0
GENERATION COUNTER
initialize population P(t)

while termination condition is not met:
REPEAT POLICY
  evaluate fitness of every member of P(t)

  select members of P(t) based on fitness

  produce offspring using crossover and mutation
CREATE VARIATION
  replace candidates in P(t) with offspring
SURVIVOR POLICY
  t ← t + 1

return the best available solution(s)

slides.title: Power comes from representation–operator fit; so does fragility
slides.visibleText:
Strength

Once representation, fitness, and operators fit the problem, population search can be compact and efficient.

representation
DETERMINES
reachable candidates
AND
legal variation
!
Limitation

Encoding can be hard. A generic operator may create invalid solutions or make useful structure difficult to discover.

GA does not remove problem formulation.

It relocates formulation into the chromosome, decoder, fitness function, population policy, operators, and stopping evidence.
